station: Model Town, Patiala - PPCB (CPCB CAAQMS station site_1437)
train_cutoff: training rows end 2024-10-19; test window starts 2024-10-20 (no overlap, asserted in code)
series_model: Retrospective reconstruction (archived near-analysis weather inputs) - chart series is this model, NOT the lead-matched rows

fit.note: rows with any missing pollutant or weather value were dropped; PM10/NO2 gaps reduce the sample though only PM2.5 is the target

models.name: Lead-matched, weather forecast issued 1 day ahead (Previous Runs API)
Lead-matched, weather forecast issued 3 days ahead (Previous Runs API)

method: LightGBM trained 2021-01-01 to 2024-10-19 on daily PM2.5 with calendar + days-to-Diwali + weather features, no pollution lags. Skill estimated by feeding archived weather forecasts issued 1 and 3 days before each test date (Open-Meteo Previous Runs API).
caveats: Single monitoring station - results are station-level, not neighbourhood-exact.
Values are PM2.5 concentrations (ug/m3) with official CPCB PM2.5 band labels; not a full National AQI (needs 3+ pollutants and official averaging rules).

This artifact covers the 2024 held-out window; the same evaluation was run on two more held-out Diwali windows (2022, 2023) and a 7-day lead test, shown under Model & Method. Errors on past windows are not proof of general forecast skill.
Daily values average whatever hourly readings exist that day (no minimum hourly coverage threshold).
